exec: pm.test("the Gateway hides service-only routes from players", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("ROUTE_NOT_FOUND"));
// A run starts at "Register a player": a fresh run_id (unique usernames, lobbies, operation ids), and the ids
// the previous run saved are forgotten, so two runs in a row never collide.
// Every request goes through the API Gateway (base url). The Gateway checks each token: HS256, signed
// with JWT_SECRET (players) or SERVICE_JWT_SECRET (services, sub "service:<name>"). Put the stack's two
// values from .env into the collection variables jwt_secret and service_jwt_secret.
return header + "." + body + "." + base64url(CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(header + "." + body, secret));
pm.collectionVariables.set("serviceToken", signJWT({ sub: "service:crafting-service", roles: ["service"], type: "service", iat: now, exp: now + 300 }, pm.variables.get("service_jwt_secret")));

pm.collectionVariables.set("playerToken", signJWT({ sub: pm.collectionVariables.get("playerId") || "postman-moderator", roles: ["player", "moderator"], type: "player", iat: now, exp: now + 3600 }, pm.variables.get("jwt_secret")));
